explanation: Carved into a cliff above three rivers between 713 and 803, the seated Buddha is 71 m tall, about 15 m more than Pisa's tower. Its ears alone are about 7 m long.

claims.text: The Leshan Giant Buddha is 71 m (233 ft) tall.
The Leaning Tower of Pisa is about 56 m (184 ft) tall.
The Leshan Giant Buddha was carved into a cliff between 713 and 803.
The Leshan Giant Buddha overlooks the meeting of three rivers.
The Leshan Giant Buddha's ears are about 7 m long.
